compute_accounting.evaluation_compute_totals: Additive per-rollout counters; NFE counts network evaluations times rows, not batch invocations. actor_nfe aliases sampling nfe during evaluation and must not be added to nfe.
compute_accounting.learner_counters: Cumulative forward-row counters for base training, guide fitting, behavior, validation and heldout; excludes warmup decoding and independent behavioral baselines. Not complete experiment FLOPs or wall cost.
compute_accounting.sampler_diagnostics: Separate from additive cost counters: ess_mean, ess_final, ess_final_fraction and log_normalizer_mean are averaged over decisions; ess_min is the minimum over decisions. These are inference diagnostics, not computational work.
